app.tagline: A shared space for this moment.
app.manualCopy: Select and copy the text below.

auth.setupDesc: Create the administrator for your RoomDeck. Guests can join without an account.
auth.tokenHelp: Find it in docker compose logs roomdeck, or in /data/setup-token. Setup is available only once.
auth.passwordHint: 12–72 bytes. Use a long, unique password.
auth.private: Self-hosted. Your files stay on your server.
auth.joinInstead: Joining a gathering? Enter a room code

home.title: Your rooms
home.subtitle: One space for every gathering, meeting, and shared moment.
home.noRooms: Every gathering starts with a room.
home.emptyHelp: Create one, invite everyone, and watch the moment come together.

join.title: You're invited.
join.subtitle: No app. No account. Just join in.
join.privacy: Content is visible to room members. Selected content may appear on the public display.
join.autoPrivacy: Photos are visible to room members and automatically appear on the public display.
join.retention: Kept for {hours} hours after the activity ends.
join.codeHint: Ask your host for the six-character room code.

room.title: The shared moment
room.subtitle: Everything shared by the people here.
room.endHelp: Sharing will stop. Existing members can view content until its scheduled deletion.
room.exportHelp: Includes original photos, files, notes, links, and available poll results. Originals may contain location metadata. Exports expire in 6 hours.
room.endedHelp: This activity has ended. Existing content is still available until {time}.
room.emptyHelp: Share a photo, a link, or a quick note with everyone here.
room.emptyPhotos: The first photo could be yours.
room.deleteHelp: This removes it from the room and public display. This cannot be undone.
room.peopleCount: No participants | {n} person joined | {n} people joined
room.addressHint: Check that this address is reachable from your guests' phones. localhost works only on this computer. Set BASE_URL for a stable public address.
room.rotateHelp: Previous invitations will stop working. Existing members stay in the room.
room.displayHelp: The display has its own read-only session. Opening it does not grant host permissions.
room.displayPairHint: Use this link on the TV within two minutes. It can be used once.
room.memberHint: Removing a member revokes this browser session. It does not prevent a person from rejoining with another device.
room.deleteRoomHint: Type the room name to delete its contents. Files in external backups are not affected.
room.displayWaitingHelp: The host can choose which moments appear here.
room.unsupportedFullscreen: Full screen is unavailable in this browser.
room.uploadHelp: Up to 20 photos per batch. JPEG, PNG or WebP, up to 20 MB each. Other files up to 200 MB.
room.uploadPrivacy: Photos are shared with the room. The host controls what appears on the display.
room.uploadAutoPrivacy: Photos are shared with the room and appear automatically on the display.
room.plainText: Plain text only. Not automatically shown on the public display.
room.hideResults: Hide results until the poll ends
room.resultsHidden: Results will be available when voting ends.
room.multipleHint: Choose up to {n}. Percentages can add up to more than 100%.
room.singleHint: Choose one option. You can change your vote before the poll ends.
room.votePrivacy: Votes are anonymous to other members. One vote per browser session; not verified identity.

settings.title: Room settings
settings.originalHint: Original files may contain GPS and other camera metadata. Preview photos have metadata removed.
settings.autoHint: When enabled, new photos appear on the public display without host selection.
settings.moduleHint: Disabling a feature hides it from guests. Existing content is kept and available to the host and exports.
settings.retentionHint: Retention is measured from the time the activity closes.

error.NETWORK_ERROR: Connection lost. Check your network and try again.
error.AUTH_REQUIRED: Your session has expired. Please sign in or join again.
error.INTERNAL_ERROR: The server could not complete this request. Please try again.
error.CREDENTIALS_INVALID: Use a username up to 40 characters and a password of 12–72 bytes.
error.SETUP_TOKEN_INVALID: The setup token is incorrect or setup is already complete.
error.RATE_LIMITED: Too many attempts. Please wait a minute.
error.ORIGIN_REJECTED: This address is not allowed. Check the deployment URL.
error.CSRF_REJECTED: Request could not be verified. Reload the page.
error.ROOM_NOT_FOUND: This room could not be found.
error.JOIN_UNAVAILABLE: The room is unavailable or no longer accepting people.
error.ROOM_FULL: This room is full. Please contact the host.
error.ROOM_CLOSED: The activity has ended. Sharing is closed.
error.ROOM_DELETED: This room has expired or been deleted.
error.FORBIDDEN: You do not have permission for this action.
error.UPLOADS_PAUSED: Sharing is paused. Please contact the host.
error.MODULE_DISABLED: This feature has been turned off by the host.
error.FILE_TOO_LARGE: This photo exceeds the 20 MB limit.
error.UNSUPPORTED_IMAGE: Use JPEG, PNG or WebP. You can share other formats as files.
error.IMAGE_TOO_LARGE: This image cannot be processed or exceeds 60 megapixels.
error.UPLOAD_INCOMPLETE: The upload did not finish. Please retry this file.
error.STORAGE_FULL: There is not enough storage. Please contact the host.
error.QUOTA_TOO_SMALL: The capacity cannot be smaller than used and reserved space.
error.RETENTION_EXPIRED: This retention period would delete the room immediately. Choose a longer period.
error.VERSION_CONFLICT: Settings changed on another device. Reload before saving.
error.INVALID_URL: Enter a valid HTTP or HTTPS address.
error.INVALID_CHOICES: Please select a valid number of options.
error.PAIR_INVALID: The display link expired or has already been used. Create a new one.
error.ORIGINAL_DISABLED: Original downloads are disabled. Download the preview photo instead.
error.NOT_FOUND: This content is no longer available.
error.NAME_MISMATCH: The room name does not match.
error.ROOM_LIMIT: The installation has reached its 100-room limit.
error.CONTENT_LIMIT: This room has reached its 2,000-item limit.
error.EXPORT_NOT_READY: The export is not ready or has expired.
error.SERVER_RESTARTED: The server restarted. Please create a new export.
error.ASSET_MISSING: A source file is missing. Check server storage.
error.NOT_READY: The server is not ready yet.
error.GAME_ACTIVE: End the current game before creating another.
error.GAME_PHASE: This action is no longer available. The game has been refreshed.
error.GAME_PLAYERS: More players need to take a seat.
error.MEDIA_UNAVAILABLE: The media service is unavailable. Other room features remain available.
error.SCREEN_BUSY: Someone is already sharing. Wait for them to stop or ask the host to end sharing.
error.SCREEN_UNSUPPORTED: This browser cannot capture your screen. Try a desktop browser over HTTPS.
error.SCREEN_DENIED: Screen sharing was cancelled or permission was denied.
error.NETWORK_TIMEOUT: The request timed out. Check your connection and refresh the state before retrying; the action may have completed.
error.UPLOAD_CONFLICT: File contents differ. Select the original file.
error.UPLOAD_EXPIRED: This upload expired. Start a new upload.
error.SCREEN_NOT_YOUR_TURN: It is not your turn or the invitation expired. Join the queue again.
error.BOARD_CHANGED: The board changed. Continue on the new canvas.
error.BOARD_FULL: The board has reached 600 stroke segments. Save an image and ask the host to clear it.

game.subtitle: Put your phones on the table. Let the game begin.
game.undercoverHelp: A different word. A familiar face. Find the undercover player.
game.undercoverRules: 4–12 players · 1 undercover · Describe aloud in seat order. Vote privately. Ties get one runoff; another tie skips elimination.
game.diceHelp: Choose a number. Lock your guess. Reveal together.
game.diceRules: 2–12 players · Guess 1–6. After all guesses are locked, the server rolls one die. An exact match earns 1 point.
game.waitHost: The host can start a game for everyone.
game.closed: The room has ended. This game is read-only.
game.secretHelp: Only you receive this word. Keep your screen private.
game.describeHelp: Describe your word aloud without saying it. The speaker or host can advance the turn.
game.voteHelp: Choose one other player. Your vote locks when submitted. A second tie starts another description round.
game.cancelHelp: End this game without revealing secret words. Create a new game to change seats.

screen.help: One person shares. Everyone in the room can watch.
screen.notConfigured: Screen sharing is not connected yet. The server administrator needs to configure the media service.
screen.unsupported: Starting screen sharing requires a supported desktop browser and HTTPS (or localhost). Mobile browsers may only support watching.
screen.privacy: Choose a window or tab you want to share. Nothing is recorded. Shared audio depends on your browser and selected source.

ui.dropFiles: Choose files or drop them here
ui.screenEmpty: Bring your screen to the room
ui.screenEmptyHelp: Choose a window, browser tab or your entire screen.
ui.choiceHelp: Choose first, then confirm. You cannot change it this round.
ui.popupBlocked: Your browser blocked the display window. Allow pop-ups for this site and try again.

displayControl.choose: Choose a poll for the display
displayControl.waiting: Waiting for the host to select a poll
displayControl.hidden: Results will appear when voting ends
displayControl.multiple: Multiple choice: percentage of voters per option

uploads.help: Uploads continue when this dialog closes. After a refresh, reselect the original file to resume.

queue.help: Join the queue, then select your screen when called.

board.title: Board / Draw & guess
board.help: Draw freely together, or take turns in a guessing game. One 90-second turn each. A correct guess earns 100 points; the artist earns 50.
board.confirmHelp: This will clear the canvas or end the current game. Make sure everyone is ready.
board.canvas: Shared canvas. Draw with a mouse or touch.
board.cancelled: This game was cancelled. Removing a player from the room also ends the game.

cohost.title: Co-host permissions
cohost.help: Grant only the duties needed. Uncheck to revoke. Muting suspends all permissions. Room settings, exports, deletion and delegation remain with the owner.
